lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 4-5 semi-horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the pectoral fin attachment, forming a non-uniform grid across the lateral midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a regular grid pattern on the mid-posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance dorsal edges and shadowed ventral troughs.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of high-luminance blobs concentrated at the base and leading edge of the first dorsal fin, becoming more sparse toward the trailing apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced traumatic injury to the trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, manifested as multiple parallel vertical clefts and missing tissue segments.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of small teleost-like silhouettes (consistent with remora associations) near the pectoral fin and ventral margin.
